subject: general
question: As of 2022, which among the following countries is the largest importer of Indian iron ore?
solution:
The correct answer is __**China.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **China is the largest importer of Indian iron ore as of 2022.**
 
• India is one of the major exporters of iron ore in the world and China is the largest consumer of this mineral.
 
• **The demand for iron ore in China has increased rapidly due to the growth of the construction and manufacturing industries.**
 
• **In recent years, India has faced challenges in exporting iron ore due to regulatory issues and environmental concerns.**
 
• Russia, France, and the United States of America are not major importers of Indian iron ore.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Russia is a major exporter of iron ore and has its own reserves of the mineral.**
 
• France and the United States of America are **not **major consumers of iron ore.
